title: Call Centre Agent
description:
Start date: 02.11.2026

Shift Pattern: Full Time (37.5 hours)

Please note that this position is a full-time role only, and part-time hours are not available.

Sales Advisors

If you're outgoing, full of energy and love talking to people, you'd be better off in sales with EE.

Maybe you've worked in retail, or hospitality before. You know how to deal with customers but you're looking for something more exciting - a job that's going to challenge you. And, of course, you want to earn a bit more cash.

Our Glasgow team's full of people like you - so you'll be in great company here.

What does being a sales advisor involve?

You'll join a lively sales team in our Glasgow contact centre. We'll train you to take incoming calls from existing EE customers and help them find the best deals on their phones and broadband. You'll also help them to navigate the different tech products we sell.

You need to be a great listener as well as a fluent talker. A lot of the time, you'll pick up on something that someone has said, then use that to match them with the perfect product.

Forget what you've heard about sales

Don't let what you've heard about sales put you off. Let's smash a few myths
- Yes, there are targets to hit. But the kind of people who like sales, love that. You're probably naturally competitive. You get a buzz out of beating the person next to you. You hate being bored at work.
- It's not "cold calling". The calls come in to you and you decide how best you can help the customer. That's why we value resourceful people who like fixing problems.
- People say it's "hard selling". It's really not! You're basically talking to people about fun tech stuff that they already want. Who doesn't love a better phone, faster broadband or a new console?

Why you'll be better off at EE

GREAT MONEY - you start on £26,116 which goes up to £26,738 after 8 months.

UNCAPPED COMMISSION - the more you sell, the more you can earn.

BRILLIANT BENEFITS - including 24/7 GP appointments for you and your family, discounted parking and discounts on EE products like phones and broadband that could save you £100s every year.

GROWTH - we're passionate about developing our people. There are plenty of career paths across EE and BT.

FLEXIBILITY - you can bank hours then take time off when you need. Plus, generous leave for carers and anyone starting a family.

GREAT PEOPLE - you're working with people like you. It's a sociable, supportive environment.

title: Claims Handler
description:
An experienced Claims Handler is required by a leading Independent Global Loss Adjusters to join their established and experienced Claims Team where you will be responsible for managing a portfolio of Property and Liability Claims cradle to grave for both the UK and Europe.

Key responsibilities:
- Investigating, negotiating and agreeing settlement of claims
- Liaising with the Insured, Insurers/Brokers on a day-to-day basis
- Liaise with stakeholders overseas
- Produce reports
- Ensure time reporting and billing is compliant
- Liaise closely with the team of Field Adjusters where appropriate
- Attend Client review meetings

About you:
- Previous Claims handling experience including caseload management
- Experience of handling Property Claims covering all general perils
- Exceptional communication skills both written and verbal
- Strong relationship management skills with the ability of establishing good working relationships with the team, colleagues and 3rd parties
- Proven capability in negotiation, decision making and problem-solving skills.
- Thrive in a high-pressured working environment
- Be driven to meet and exceed targets
- Industry qualifications, working towards or be keen to study and work towards
- Be happy to work from on office base 2/3 days per week

Salary and Benefits:
- Competitive Annual Basic Salary

Full support towards Industry qualification as well as support towards career progression and development
- Hours are Monday to Friday 9.00am-5.00pm
- 25 days holiday per annum plus bank holidays
- Healthcare Scheme
- Pension - 8% Employer, 2 % Employee
- Life Assurance
- Health Insurance

title: Conveyancing Paralegal
description:
This is a great time to join a growing Residential Conveyancing team in Glasgow.

Following continued growth and further expansion of the team, I am looking to speak with experienced Residential Conveyancing Paralegals who would like to join a firm that is genuinely going places, but which has retained a relaxed, supportive and very grown up approach to how people work.

For someone who enjoys managing their own caseload and wants the autonomy to get on with their job without being micromanaged, I think this is a particularly attractive opportunity.

You will manage your own residential conveyancing caseload from instruction through to completion, dealing directly with clients and taking ownership of your transactions. You will have experienced people around you when you need them, but equally you will be trusted to manage your workload and your clients in your own way.

What really stands out to me is the culture.

This is a supportive, friendly environment where people are treated like adults. There is good flexibility and, following an initial settling in period, the opportunity to work on a hybrid basis. Just as importantly, this is a firm that wants its people to develop and actively encourages progression and growth.

With the team continuing to expand, it is a really good time to come on board and be part of what they are building.

You should have at least a years experience managing your own residential conveyancing caseload and be comfortable handling transactions from start to finish.

Alongside a competitive salary, the firm offers good flexibility, private healthcare and a discretionary bonus.

If you are an experienced Residential Conveyancing Paralegal in Glasgow and would like to join a growing team where you will be trusted, supported and given the opportunity to develop, please get in touch with me for a confidential conversation.
working_arrangement_evidence: There is good flexibility and, following an initial settling in period, the opportunity to work on a hybrid basis.

title: Conveyancing Paralegal / Conveyancer
description:
An opportunity has arisen for a Residential Conveyancing Paralegal / Conveyancer to join a well-established company offering estate agency, letting, legal, and mortgage services, alongside regulated support for buying, selling, and property management.

As a Residential Conveyancing Paralegal / Conveyancer, you will assist a solicitor with day-to-day residential conveyancing matters, supporting transactions from instruction through to completion.

This role offers a salary range of £30,000 - £35,000 (DOE) and benefits. Conveyancing Legal Secretary, Fee earner or Assistant Solicitor may also be considered for this role.

The candidates from the following background will be considered:
- Residential Conveyancing Paralegal, Conveyancer, Conveyancing Paralegal, Paralegal, Conveyancing Assistant, legal assistant, or in a similar role

What we are looking for:
- At least 2 years of experience within residential conveyancing in Scotland
- Strong practical knowledge of conveyancing processes and documentation
- Ability to manage a varied caseload and work with accuracy under pressure
- A proactive and organised approach to workload management

This is a great opportunity for a Residential Conveyancing Paralegal / Conveyancer looking to develop their career within residential conveyancing in a well-regarded legal environment.

title: Family Paralegal
description:
Join an award-winning firm as a Family Law Paralegal, playing a key role in delivering an outstanding client experience.

If you're a Family Law Paralegal with at least 2 years' experience, this is a great opportunity to join a forward-looking firm where people genuinely enjoy the culture - built around care, drive, integrity, passion and putting clients first.

What's on offer?
- Hybrid working
- Private health scheme
- Life assurance
- Income protection
- Bonus scheme
- Regular staff celebrations, rewards and social days out

The role
As Family Law Paralegal, you'll get involved in every stage of family law casework, including:
- Booking client appointments and keeping them in the loop
- Taking precognitions and coordinating witnesses
- Drafting Minutes of Agreement and other legal documents
- Helping prepare Affidavits
- Putting together schedules of matrimonial property and checking vouching
- Handling correspondence with clients and other parties

About you
- At least 2 years' experience in family law
- Driven and motivated to deliver a first-class client experience
- Great people skills
- Comfortable working towards KPI targets
- Personable, detail-focused and confident
- Happy to pitch in and support the wider team

The environment
You'll be joining a firm that puts real value on its people with regular recognition, rewards and social events, all underpinned by a culture of care, drive, integrity, passion and client focus.

If you're a Family Law Paralegal considering your next move, we would welcome a confidential chat.

How to Apply:

Online: Submit your updated CV via the application link provided.
Contact: For immediate consideration contact Becky Newton at G2 Legal.

We look forward to hearing from you.

As a Lettings Administrator, you will be supporting the lettings team with property administration, viewings, maintenance enquiries and day-to-day customer communication.

This full-time role offers a salary range of £26,000 - £33,000 and benefits.

title: Resourcing Coordinator (Maternity Cover)
company: Mission Aviation Fellowship UK - Agency - Permanent
description:
Mission Aviation Fellowship (MAF) is seeking an organised and creative MAF in the Community (MiC) Resourcing Coordinator to support our vital resourcing and community fundraising work across the UK.

This is a rewarding opportunity for a dedicated administrator to use their skills to equip our staff, volunteers and church representatives, helping them inspire new donors and supporters to get behind our life-changing work.

Location: Folkestone or Glasgow (with hybrid working)

Contract: 12 month, fixed-term maternity contract

As an MAF in the Community (MiC) Resourcing Coordinator, you will support the day-to-day delivery of MiC UK's resourcing and community fundraising activities.

Working under the direction of the MiC Resourcing Lead, you will help develop and maintain engaging resources for churches, volunteers and other stakeholders, ensuring they have the materials and information they need to promote MAF and attract new donors and supporters.

You will also support the development of community fundraising plans, campaigns and supporter engagement, providing groups and individuals with resources and advice to help maximise fundraising income and attract new supporters.

Additionally, you will:
- Gather content for quarterly MiC Church newsletters
- Update volunteer, website, e-news and social media content
- Help develop new church and audience engagement resources
- Assist with the planning and delivery of MiC UK events
- Manage queries and meeting and speaking engagement paperwork

About You

To be considered as an MAF in the Community (MiC) Resourcing Coordinator, you will need:
- Experience in an administrative role
- Experience of working in an office environment
- Proficiency in Microsoft applications
- The ability to communicate positively, assertively and sensitively within a cross-functional team environment
- An efficient and organised approach
- The ability to manage multiple deadlines and priorities
- Excellent attention to detail
- The ability to work on your own initiative
- Creativity and innovation
- At a minimum, A-levels or equivalent experience

About Us

Mission Aviation Fellowship (MAF) is a Christian organisation that uses light aircraft to deliver practical help, physical healing and spiritual hope to some of the world's most remote and inaccessible communities.

For 80 years, MAF has been working in partnership with hundreds of other organisations to enable access to medical care, education, livelihood training and long-term support in over 24 low-income countries.

They believe that every community, however remote, should have access to the essentials of life - that's why MAF's flights are a lifeline, not a luxury.

The Benefits
- Salary of £28,701.28 per annum
- Annual leave entitlement of 22 days per year plus 8 paid public holidays per year
- Non-contributory pension scheme (10% of salary); employees may make voluntary additional contributions
- Death in service payment
- Flexible working policy
- Access to our Employee Assistance Programme

This is a rewarding opportunity for an organised administrator with experience to join our purpose-driven Christian organisation.

You'll enjoy a varied role spanning resourcing, community fundraising, events and communications, giving you the chance to broaden your experience, put your creativity to great use and develop a diverse range of skills.

Perhaps most rewarding of all, your work will help equip the people who champion MAF across the UK, supporting them to reach new audiences and inspire more people to get behind our life-changing work around the world.
